ctx.x: -- last gigs. I had a gig with Vernell Fournier (PHONETIC) out at one of the vocalist clubs. Lurlene Hunter (PHONETIC), young lady been around Chicago for years, good vocalist. She never made what you would call the big time, but she was very well respected. But she had a club. She had

this trio. Vernell the trio in that. Vernell had Willie Pickens on piano, a wonderful Chicago pianist, and he had Nevins Wilson (PHONETIC), my old boy who had [unintelligible] on bass and Nevins had a drinking problem.
